title: My Quiet Bible · Kenkan, bɔ mpae, kyɛ, san yɛ bio
description: Kenkan, bɔ mpae, kyɛ, san yɛ bio. Bible no wɔ Bible ahodoɔ {{versions}} ne kasa {{languages}} mu, 🙏 bɔtɔn a wode bɔ mpae dennen fa deɛ wokenkan ho, ne akuw nketewa a ɛyɛ kokoam a wode kyɛ wo mpaebɔ. Ɛyɛ kwa, dawurubɔ biara nni mu, na ɛyɛ adwuma a intanɛt nni hɔ mpo.
lead: Kenkan, bɔ mpae, kyɛ, san yɛ bio.
sub: Bible no nko ara: nkenkan nhyehyɛe biara nni hɔ, nsɛm a ɛtoatoa so biara nni hɔ, dawurubɔ biara nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ kwa, na ɛyɛ adwuma a intanɛt nni hɔ mpo.
homeScreen: Fa to wo Home Screen so
installAndroid: Fa to wo Android fon so
hint: Wonhia sɛ wokyerɛw wo din. Ɛbue wɔ ha ara wɔ wo browser mu.
verseH: Wɔ wo ankasa wo kasa mu
verseSub:
Bible ahodoɔ {{versions}} wɔ kasa {{languages}} mu, ne nyinaa yɛ ɔmanfoɔ dea anaa wɔama kwan pefee.
          Nkyekyɛm koro no ara, wɔ wɔn mu kakra mu:
biblesP: Bible ahodoɔ {{versions}} wɔ kasa {{languages}} mu: King James, Louis Segond 1910, Luther, Reina-Valera, Hebri Bible ne Greek Apam Foforo, Etiopia nhoma wɔ Borɔfo, Franse ne Ge'ez kasa mu, ne afoforo. Toto nsia ho nkyɛn-nkyɛn.
searchP: Asɛmfua, kasasin, nsɛmfua mmienu a ɛbɛn wɔn ho, wɔ Bible baako anaa pii mu, na wɔkan nea wohunu wɔ nhoma biara mu. Kyerɛw beaeɛ bi na woaduru hɔ. Strong's nɔma nso wɔ hɔ.
offlineH: Ɛyɛ adwuma a intanɛt nni hɔ
offlineP: Bible a wokenkan no tena wo fon so. Wɔ wimhyɛn mu, wɔ mmepɔ so, wɔ ɔdan ase: ɛbue wɔ nkyekyɛm a wogyae hɔ no so, a intanɛt biara nni hɔ.
marksP: Kɔla nwɔtwe, nkaeɛ wɔ nkyekyɛm anaa beaeɛ nyinaa so, agyiraehyɛde ma mmeae a wosan kɔ. Fa deɛ wokoraa wɔ Bible app foforo mu bra. Hyɛ nkyekyem bi agyirae te sɛ highlighter, anaa fa kɔla hyɛ ne nkyerɛwde mu.
devicesP: Sɛ wopɛ nko ara. Fa passkey anaa code a wɔde mane wo wɔ email so kɔ mu, na wo kɔla nsɛm, wo nkaeɛ ne wo nhyehyɛe di w’akyi. Afidie a ɛtɔ so mmienu de link baako fi nea edi kan no so kɔ mu; biribiara nni hɔ a wobɛkyerɛw.
verseShareP: Fa nkyekyem bi kɔ WhatsApp, Facebook anaa X wɔ mfiri baako so, sɛ mfoni a ɛyɛ dinn a wɔyɛɛ no wɔ w’ankasa wo afiri so.
readingP: Nkyerɛwee ahodoɔ nsia, baako yɛ ma wɔn a wɔn ani nhu ade yie. Nkyerɛwee kɛseɛ biara a wohia, ne bɔtɔn a worentumi mmfom. Twe na dane ti no. Hann, Sepia anaa Sum, te sɛ saa krataafa yi.
nots:
• Nkenkan nhyehyɛe biara nni hɔ. Da biara nsɛm biara nni hɔ. Hwee nni hɔ a obi ayi ama wo.
  • Dawurubɔ biara nni hɔ. Obiara nni w’akyi. Cookies biara nni hɔ.
  • Wontua hwee. Biribiara nto mu.
  • Wonhia akawnt. Kɔ mu sɛ wopɛ sync nko ara.
free: My Quiet Bible yɛ kwa, na ɛbɛyɛ kwa daa. Sɛ ɛboa wo a, wobɛtumi aboa ma kanea no nkɔ so nhyerɛn. Biribiara rennyina so da.
installSub: Afei ɛbue screen no nyinaa so te sɛ app foforo biara, ɛkae faako a wowɔ, na ɛyɛ adwuma a intanɛt nni hɔ.
installSubComputer: Afei ɛbue wɔ ne window mu te sɛ app foforo biara, ɛkae faako a wowɔ, na ɛyɛ adwuma a intanɛt nni hɔ.
iosSteps:
• Bue Bible no wɔ Safari mu.
  • Mia menu bɔtɔn a ɛwɔ address bar no mu, afei Share {svg}. Wɔ iPhone dedaw so, Share wɔ ase hɔ dua no mu pɛ.
  • Mia View More, afei Add to Home Screen {svg}.
  • Ma Open as Web App ntena so na mia Add. Kanea no bɛda adi wɔ wo Home Screen so.
iosNote: Yɛ no fi Bible no mu, ɛnyɛ saa krataafa yi, na kanea no abue tẽẽ akɔ wo nkenkan so. Fa Safari di dwuma: browser foforo a ɛwɔ iPhone ne iPad so ntumi mfa app nka ho bere biara.
install: Fa My Quiet Bible hyɛ mu
orSafari: Anaa, a App Store nni mu, fi Safari mu:
androidNote: Mia baako pɛ. Biribiara mfa app store biara mu.
androidInstalled: Wɔde ahyɛ mu. Bue kanea no wɔ w’app foforo no ho.
androidSteps:
• Bue Bible no wɔ Chrome mu, anaa browser a wode di dwuma.
  • Bue browser no menu, ɛtaa yɛ nsensanee mmiɛnsa {svg} wɔ soro nifa.
  • Mia Install and create shortcut (browser binom ka sɛ Add to Home screen).
  • Yi Install, ɛnyɛ Create shortcut. Afei san mia Install.
  • Kanea no bɛda adi wɔ w’app foforo no ho.
computerNote: Ɛbue wɔ ne window mu, te sɛ app foforo biara.
computerInstalled: Wɔde ahyɛ mu. Bue My Quiet Bible wɔ w’app foforo no ho.
computerSteps:
• Bue Bible no wɔ Chrome anaa Edge mu.
  • Mia install icon a ɛwɔ address bar no nifa ano, screen a agyan wɔ so {svg}, afei Install.
  • Anaa ma tab no ntena hɔ kɛkɛ. Ɛyɛ adwuma saa ara, na ɛkae faako a wowɔ.
footNote: Nsɛm no nyinaa yɛ ɔmanfoɔ dea anaa wɔama kwan pefee. Bible biara ne tumi krataa wɔ app no mu.
readP: Bible no, wɔ Bible ahodoɔ {{versions}} mu, kwa.
prayP: dennen, bɔtɔn baako pɛ, fa deɛ woakenkan seesei ho.
shareP: wo mpaebɔ, bere a wopɛ, ne nnipa kakra a wɔbɛn wo.
repeatP: ɔkyena. Ɛkae faako a wowɔ, ne nna a woatoatoa so.
prayH: Bɔ mpae wɔ bɔtɔn baako so
prayLong: 🙏 bɔtɔn no wɔ hɔ bere nyinaa, wɔ nhwehwɛmu dua no nkyɛn. Mia so na bɔ wo mpae dennen. Wɔkora no ne nkyekyɛm a na woakenkan no bom, na akyire yi wobɛtumi asan ate na woahu deɛ wobɔɔ ho mpae.
prayTicks:
• Biribiara nni hɔ a wobɛkyerɛw, na biribiara nni hɔ a wobɛsiesie.
  • Wo mpaebɔ tena wo fon so, anaa ɛbɔ ho sync a wɔde safoa a wo nko ara wowɔ ato mu.
  • Amen akyi no, hwɛ aman a nnipa bɔɔ mpae wɔ hɔ nnawɔtwe yi. Ɔman no nko ara na wɔkan.
circlesH: Mommɔ mpae bom, wɔ kuw mu
circlesVerse: “Na baabi a baanu anaa baasa ahyia wɔ me din mu no, ɛhɔ na mewɔ wɔn mfimfini.”
circlesLong: Sɛ wopɛ a, yɛ kuw ketewa ma w’abusua anaa nnamfo kakra. Kyɛ mpaebɔ, nkyekyɛm anaa nkaeɛ wɔ mia baako so. Wɔtie, wɔde asɛm bi bua, anaa wɔde 🙏 bua, na obiara kenkan nkyekyɛm no wɔ ne Bible mu.
circlesAsk: Srɛ wo kuw no ma wɔmmɔ mpae mma wo, na hwɛ sɛ nnipa dodoɔ bɛn na wɔabɔ mpae.
circlesTicks:
• Ɛho nhia da. Biribiara mfi wo fon so gye sɛ wo mia Kyɛ.
  • Kuw biara wɔ ne safoa. Ne mufoɔ nko ara na wobetumi abue deɛ ɛwɔ mu; yɛn mpo yɛntumi.
  • Akuw hia sɛ wokɔ mu kwa, de passkey anaa koodu a wɔde email mena.
listenP: Mia nkyekyem bi so, na afei Tie. Ɛkenkan fi hɔ kosi sɛ wobɛgyae, na asɛmfua biara hyerɛn bere a wɔrekenkan no. Akenkanfo ankasa kenkan BSB, King James ne Louis Segond. Ma kar mu, mukaase, anaa aniwa a abrɛ.
